name: Far Lands
description: Replicates the 14 iconic Minecraft Far Lands biomes (Skygrid, NetherGrid, EndIsland, Stripe, Strip, Corner, Farther, 64-bit, Vertex, Comb, Pole, Edge Loop, Tunnel, Nothingness) as a worldgen ring around the map border. Each band of distance from the border picks a different glitched terrain type. Pure worldgen, zero runtime cost outside the ring.
